target.title: fix(ui): isolate retained test elements
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The non-isolated Control UI test runner resets modules while jsdom retains its custom-element registry. The terminal and native-link tests used fixed test tags, so a later module evaluation could mount a constructor retained from an earlier graph. The terminal suite then talked to stale mocks and failed six otherwise unrelated tests.

## Why This Change Was Made

Give each module evaluation a fresh UUID-suffixed custom-element tag. The terminal test can register its current subclass unconditionally; the native-link test now creates the dynamic tag imperatively while preserving the same properties and connection order.

This completes the isolation intent of #103345. Fixed conditional registrations still collide after the same test module is evaluated again; fresh tags match the established pattern in sibling Control UI tests.

## User Impact

No product behavior changes. Control UI CI no longer fails unrelated PRs because terminal and locale-sensitive tests bind to stale constructors.

## Evidence

- Reproduction: `checks-ui` failed the same six terminal tests on #105702 and twice on #105705; requests and current mocks stayed empty because the mounted element came from a retained module graph.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxc36pewy25jaybwag50434x`: focused terminal/native-link tests passed 12/12.
- Same Testbox: full Control UI suite passed 233 files and 3,695 tests.
- Same Testbox: scoped `pnpm check:changed` passed type, lint, and format gates.
- Testbox workflow: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29209424062
- Fresh `gpt-5.6-sol` autoreview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings, correctness confidence 0.96.
